semantics: CAS compare-and-set PUBLISHED_VERIFIED -> PENDING_GITHUB_TERMINALIZATION using the exact observed revision; no delete, seed, reset, direct SQLite edit or in-place history rewrite.

Append exactly one ADS v4.18 event-v2 DISPATCH_STATE_CHANGED with actor_role=scheduler and an existing terminal dispatch_state; for #203 the proposed state is DONE because the candidate-publication dispatch completed its publication operation.

Bind the terminal event to the original task/issue, source SHA, dispatch_id, protected_claim_key, admission_generation, predecessor Claim comment ID/ref, reason, durable evidence references and occurred_at.
Read all native GitHub comments with complete pagination and verify exactly one unedited exact terminal event matching the reservation and predecessor Claim.
CAS compare-and-set PENDING_GITHUB_TERMINALIZATION -> TERMINAL_VERIFIED using the exact reservation revision; persist terminal comment ID/ref and preserve the original Claim comment ID/ref.
Lost ACK, incomplete read, duplicate/conflicting/edited event, stale source, revision mismatch or unknown effect remains UNKNOWN/pending; no blind POST retry and no successor Claim.
A terminal row is not an active incompatible Claim; pending/unknown rows remain incompatible and fail closed.
DONE terminates only the dispatch execution authority. It does not imply Task PASS, CI PASS, PR merge, Release PASS, Issue closure or Deployment.
